title: Matrices and Determinants
seo_title: Matrices – SSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Add, subtract and multiply matrices; find the determinant and inverse of a 2 × 2 matrix; solve simultaneous equations with matrices. (summary of the NERDC SSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 3 maths worksheets on matrices: order, addition, scalar and matrix multiplication, determinants, inverse matrices and solving equations. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: det of (a b; c d) = ad − bc
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A matrix of order m × n has m rows and n columns. Add only matrices of the same order.
  • To multiply, take row × column: multiply in pairs and add.
  • For a 2 × 2 matrix, the determinant is ad − bc. If it is 0, there is no inverse.

Examples

Example

det (3 2; 1 4)

3 × 4 − 2 × 1

Answer: 10

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Multiplying matching entriesUse row × column.
Thinking AB = BAMatrix multiplication is not commutative.
Forgetting to swap a and d in the inverseSwap a and d, change the signs of b and c.

faq.q: When can two matrices be multiplied?
faq.a: When the columns of the first = the rows of the second.
